 Inspiration 

 My love of techno and casual DJing inspired Mixerx—a fun break from my finance and AI projects. 

 How I built it 

 I combined React, Web Audio, WebGPU, and WebMCP to build a browser DJ tool with local audio, reactive visuals, and optional AI assistance. 

 What I learned 

 I explored audio timing, graphics, and creative agent interactions. 

 Challenges 

 Coordinating sound, visuals, and AI actions while keeping the DJ in control.
